name: {{PREFIX}} Enterprise LLM Failures Detected
message: Enterprise LLM runtime recorded at least one post-retry LLM failure. Review provider health, fallback behavior, and the governance runtime board.

name: {{PREFIX}} Enterprise LLM Refusals Spiking
message: Safety or policy refusals spiked above the agreed baseline. Review request mix, prompt-injection pressure, and recent rule changes before rollout.

name: {{PREFIX}} Enterprise LLM Circuit Opened
message: An LLM circuit breaker opened in the last 30 minutes. Check provider stability, fallback behavior, and cost-control posture before continuing rollout.
